SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.I. Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 16, 37

Subject Shanghai Vocational Youth's War Time Service Group - Warning issued.

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by C. Crawford

With reference to this Section's report of October 13, on the above subject: I have to report that the offices of the above group are no longer situated at 424 Foochow Road - they having been removed to the Wu Shih (務實) School, 77 Foh Yen Road Nantao. However, although this group intends to confine its activities mainly to places outside the Settlement, it nevertheless intends to conduct a certain amount of broadcasting and propaganda work in hospitals for wounded soldiers situated within the Settlement. Therefore, in accordance with the instructions of the D.C. (Special Branch) appended to the aforementioned report the General Secretary of the Group, Mr. Shih Ping-yang (施炳揚), was interviewed at Police Headquarters on October 15 when he, and through him his group, was warned to refrain from doing any propaganda work, pasting wall-posters, delivering speeches or broadcasting songs or plays or taking part in any sort of mass demonstration contrary to Police Laws. He duly acknowledged the warning and stated he would convey the instructions of the police in this matter to his committee.

D.S.I. Laurier
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

档案号。
S.I. 特别股
报告
日期：1937年10月16日

主题：上海职业青年战时服务团——已发出警告。

制作人：副督察长 Laurier 转呈人：C. Crawford

关于本股于10月13日就上述主题提交的报告：兹报告，该团办事处已不再位于福州路424号，而是迁至南市佛衍路77号务实学校。然而，尽管该团打算将其活动主要限制在租界以外的地区，但它仍打算在位于租界内的伤兵医院开展一定数量的广播和宣传工作。因此，根据附在上述报告后的特别股助理处长（D.C. (Special Branch)）的指示，该团总干事施炳扬先生于10月15日在警察总局接受了问询。当时对他及其所代表的团体提出了警告，要求其不得进行任何违反警务法规的宣传工作、张贴壁报、发表演讲、广播歌曲或戏剧，或参与任何形式的群众示威。他正式承认了该警告，并表示会将警方在此事上的指示传达给他的委员会。

副督察长 Laurier
副督察长

特别股助理处长。
归档
10月17日

S.I, Special Branch XXXX
REPORT
Date October 13, 19 37

Subject (in full) Shanghai Vocational Youth's War Time Service Group -
- New Body formed.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Ganson

A new organization entitled the "Shanghai Vocational
Youth's War Time Service Group" (上海職業青年戰時服務團)
has come into existence at 424 Foochow Road (Louza District).
Mr. Feng Sao-san (少山), ex-Chairman of the
former Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce and at present a
committee member of the Cantonese Fellow Countrymen's Association,
is Chief of the group, and Mr. Shih Ping-yang (石炳揚),
Manager of the Sales Department of the Er Dong (兒童) Bookstore,
424 Foochow Road, is General Secretary. The group claims
to have 300 members.

The work to be performed by this group, it is
reported, will consist of the following :-
a) To render first aid service to wounded soldiers and to
repair the roadways behind the Chinese lines.
b) To carry out propaganda work which will take the form of the
posting of wall news papers, the delivering of speeches, the
broadcasting of songs and the promotion of choral singing
which will be of a national salvation nature.
c) To visit and console wounded soldiers in hospitals.

报告
日期：1937年10月13日

主题（全称）：上海职业青年战时服务团——
——新成立的团体。

制作人：副督察长 Kao Yen-ken 转呈人：C. Ganson

一个名为“上海职业青年战时服务团”的新组织已在福州路424号（老闸区）成立。前上海总商会主席、现任广东同乡会委员冯少山先生担任该团团长，福州路424号儿童书店销售部经理石炳扬先生担任总干事。该团声称拥有300名成员。

据报，该团将执行的工作包括以下内容：
a) 为伤兵提供急救服务，并修复中国军队防线后方的道路。
b) 开展宣传工作，形式包括张贴壁报、发表演讲、广播歌曲以及推广具有救国性质的合唱。
c) 前往医院慰问伤兵。

（批注：S.I. 于10月6日转呈）
